The new BMW X5 has been unveiled, and we’re reviewing the design, interior, back seats, boot space, and revealing the different engine & battery options.

The all-new BMW X5 is here! 

Mat’s flown over to Germany to get up close and personal with this all-new BMW SUV. The question is, will it be an improvement on the previous generation? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of the design, one of the most striking elements is the use of the X in the LED headlights! There are two Xs on either side of the front end, used as either adaptive headlights or for the hazard warning lights. They sit on either side of a thin, vertical grille that comes with light surrounds, with all of these sitting above an aggressive-looking front bumper.
